name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over a different protocol than that of the existing command and control channel. Data may be sent over DNS, FTP, SMTP, or other protocols distinct from the main C2, sometimes to a separate destination, to evade controls focused on the C2 path.
detection: Monitor for unexpected protocol usage and volume anomalies, such as large DNS TXT queries or outbound FTP/SMTP from hosts that do not normally use them. Analyze egress for protocols leaving the environment to unusual destinations.
